verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents several headless, programmatic surfaces. The official Snowflake CLI manages apps across workloads, and the SQL API can submit, check and cancel statements and manage deployments. The REST APIs are described as enabling "end-to-end automation", with OpenAPI specs and drivers alongside. A community user also reports running COPY-based automations daily. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline documentation (e.g. GitHub Actions or other CI integration), documented non-interactive/service-account authentication for the CLI, and hands-on corroboration of CLI use in CI.
